ValidationRule.description: Quality Case Records when the Case Reason is Package or Product should always have a Agent Message and Purchase ZIp Code.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(ISPICKVAL( Country_Code__c ,'US'), OR($UserRole.Name ='CCNA Frontline Agent', $UserRole.Name ='CCNA Specialist User'), NOT($Profile.Name='CCNA Bottler'), RecordType.DeveloperName = 'NA_Quality', OR(ISPICKVAL( Reason ,'Product'), ISPICKVAL( Reason ,'Package') ), NOT(ISPICKVAL( Status ,'New')), If(OR(ISPICKVAL(Agent_Message_Code__c,''),ISBLANK(Purchase_Zip_Code__c)), True, If(Account.Mailing_State_Code__pc<>null, OR(Purchase_Zip_Code__c='a095A000014zFoJ',Purchase_Zip_Code__c='a095A0000150rEF',Purchase_Zip_Code__c='a095A0000150Mvb'), ISBLANK(Purchase_Zip_Code__c) ) ), Point_Of_Purchase_Type__c<>'Online-Purchase', CreatedDate > DATETIMEVALUE("2023-06-14 00:00:00") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: (1) Message code and Purchase Zip Code is required for Quality Package and Product complaints. (2) Purchase Zip Code cannot contain NOZIP if Postal Code (Physical Address) exists.
